structured_output.body:
Dear Professor Smit,

I am a student in the BSc International Business Administration at Rotterdam School of Management (2023–2027), following the finance specialisation with an average of 8.3 out of 10, and in 2023-2024 block 1 I took your course Financial Accounting (ACC-1010). I also spent an exchange semester at the University of Virginia McIntire School of Commerce in Fall 2026.

Your course introduced financial reporting under IFRS, working through the balance sheet, income statement and cash flow statement, accrual accounting, revenue recognition, inventories, fixed assets and depreciation, before turning to the analysis of financial statements with ratios. I would like to build on these topics in a master's programme in finance.

As a research assistant in an empirical finance group, from January to June 2026, I cleaned stock return data and ran event studies for a working paper on dividend announcements. I intend to work as a quantitative researcher in asset management, building and testing systematic investment strategies.

The programme and its deadline:
- MIT Sloan MFin: 5 January 2027

Should it be useful, I would gladly send my CV, my transcript and a brief summary of points you could speak to. Would you feel able to write a strong letter of recommendation in support of this application? Thank you for considering my request; I appreciate that it asks for your time.

Kind regards,
Daan Hendriks
warnings: No grade given for Financial Accounting (ACC-1010), so the email does not mention one.
